hypothesis: At e in [0, 0.85], the low raw accel_step R2 (0.54-0.57 at 600 steps for seeds 71/72) is a limit of linear readout, not undertraining. This matches the 6-layer d_model=128 plateau near 0.70-0.74 (f-20261012-030233-ab28). Training the 4-layer d_model=64 model 5x longer keeps improving prediction but barely moves raw linear decodability.
expected_if_true: In all 3 seeds, raw layer-4 accel_step R2 at step 3000 is <= 0.65 and within 0.05 of its step-750 value, while val_mse_ratio falls by >= 2x between step 750 and step 3000. The accel_step margin stays >= 0.1 over the best-of-5 control throughout.
expected_if_false: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, raw accel_step R2 at step 3000 is >= 0.08 above its step-750 value or reaches >= 0.70, so the high-e decodability gap is mostly undertraining.
